Single Replication from the Simulation Study

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Source: vignettes/sim-rep.Rmd
sim-rep.Rmd
library(OpenMx)
library(fitDTVARMxID)
library(metaVAR)
library(manMetaVAR)

Data Generation 

taskid <- 1
seed <- 42
set.seed(seed)
data <- GenData(taskid = taskid)
plot(data)

summary(data)
#>        id            time             y1                y2

#>  1st Qu.:13.0   1st Qu.:24.75   1st Qu.:-0.1779   1st Qu.:-1.1083

#>  3rd Qu.:38.0   3rd Qu.:74.25   3rd Qu.: 1.2960   3rd Qu.: 0.2786  
#>  Max.   :50.0   Max.   :99.00   Max.   : 5.8231   Max.   : 3.9639

MetaVAR 

dtvar <- FitDTVAR(data)
summary(dtvar, means = TRUE)
